title: US Minimum Wage by State (2024 Update)
summary: Check your state's minimum wage in 2024! This essential guide can help you understand your rights and advocate for fair pay.
body_markdown:
As we enter 2024, it's crucial for workers to be aware of the minimum wage in their respective states. With the cost of living constantly on the rise, knowing your state's minimum wage can make a significant difference in your financial well-being. Let's dive into the minimum wage rates across the United States for 2024.

In Alabama, the minimum wage remains at $7.25 per hour, the federal minimum wage.
